_doc: F01 stage 1e: first motion test of a crave shot (Kling 3.0 Pro i2v, 5 s).

args.prompt: Very slow cinematic push-in on the ice-cold bottle. The large water droplet slides down through the embossed AURUM letters leaving a glossy trail, other condensation beads tremble and a few start to run down the glass. A thin wisp of cold vapour curls off the shoulder of the bottle. Golden bokeh in the background drifts gently. A soft light sweep glides across the brushed-gold cap. Smooth, realistic, luxury commercial, no camera shake, the label and letters stay exactly the same.
